ns2:section.sectionText: Organizational communication is a crucial tool for driving positive change within communities. This course examines how organizations, through their multi-level communication processes, mitigate a range of community issues—locally and globally—including socio-political, environmental, and cultural disruptions. Students will explore how organizations utilize both internal and external communication (e.g., networks, mission statements, corporate social responsibility) as tools to foster positive change. The course integrates theoretical frameworks with practical applications, enabling students to analyze and expand their knowledge at the intersection of organizational communication and community scholarship.
